lineage.note: Both sides read the repaired visual lines. Only block grouping differs, so the numbers below belong to this stage alone.

rule.statement: Two lines continue each other when the gap between them is no more than the document's own leading, plus a tolerance.
rule.leadingDefinition: The smallest gap, in line-heights, that recurs in at least 5% of the document's line pairs.
rule.whyNotAbsolute: Measured across this repository's PDF corpus the leading and the paragraph break are always separate populations but never in the same place twice - one document wraps at 1.05 line-heights and breaks at 1.45, another wraps at 1.40 and breaks at 2.25. No fixed ceiling sits between both pairs.
rule.degenerateCase: A document with too few line pairs to measure has no leading to read. The estimate is clamped to a plausible range and falls back to its lower bound, which merges nothing that a single measured gap would not already justify.
rule.normalizedBy: max(declared font size, drawn line height). DOC-0252 reports a font size of 1.0 for every glyph, so height is what carries the scale there.
